changeSet.comment: Test data for rooms from hotel schema
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO hotel.rooms (description, dict_room_type_id, hotel_id, created_at) SELECT CONCAT('Room ', gs, ' in hotel ', t.hotel_id) AS description, ROUND(1 + random() * 3) AS dict_room_type_id, t.hotel_id, NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' FROM tmp_hotel_room_counts t, generate_series(1, t.room_count) AS gs
